defect_location.description: CVE-2022-32221: PUT 之后复用 handle 发 POST 时错误调用读回调（CVE 描述: might erroneously use the read callback ... even when CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS has been set, if the same handle previously was used to issue a PUT request）。状态逻辑错误 → 诚实标 miss。

source.simplification: 剥离连接复用层，保留『同一 handle 先做 PUT(读回调) 再 POST(POSTFIELDS) 时错误调用读回调』核心状态缺陷

trigger_condition: 同一 handle 先 PUT(读回调) 再 POST(POSTFIELDS)，发送阶段错误调用读回调
